scope: Same-assistant unblinded source review of three frozen model outputs for the exposed Mali docket. The public record is author-supplied and common to every policy.

records.record:
On 30 August 2023 [docket], France and the UAE's S/2023/638 proposed renewing sanctions and extending the Panel of Experts. It failed 13–1–1 owing to Russia's permanent-member veto. France voted in favour [status-638].

Russia's separate draft S/2023/639 proposed a final extension and immediate dissolution of the Panel. It failed 1–1–13 for insufficient votes in favour. Russia voted yes, Japan voted no, and France abstained [status-639].

Both drafts proposed a temporary sanctions extension. They differed over the Panel's continuation and whether the extension would be final. Neither draft was adopted or created authority [status-638, status-639].
